xivc

A work-in-progress viewer of FFXIV clothing to help you make glams. Please note that FFXIV characters are very complex and will never look exactly as they look in game.

Controls

  • Drag on the viewport to orbit the camera
  • Shift+drag to pan the camera
  • Scroll to zoom
  • Toggle Freecam (top left) to fly around with WASD and mouse-look

Spoiler Warning: Due to the tool reading the game files it may leak upcoming/unreleased equipments and customization options.

Data Usage Warning: This website constantly loads and unloads the 3D models from the real game, as such it requires a lot of data. Please avoid using this on limited WIFI or mobile data.

Browser Requirements: The website was built using modern technologies for performance. An updated browser is required. Please make sure your browser is fully updated when using this website.

All models are copyright of Square Enix Holdings Co., Ltd. as such, exporting raw models is impossible. xivc is not affiliated with Square Enix Holdings or its subsidiaries, this is a fan project.

Made by Chloe Cinders .

Credits

  • https://xivmodding.com/ : Reference for the entire rendering pipeline, quirks in textures, basically everything, huge thanks!
  • PassiveModding/Meddle : Reference for rendering of the player bodies/faces
  • TexTools/FFXIV_TexTools_UI : Reference for extracting blocks from SqPack DATs, reference for basic rendering of equipment
  • xivapi/ffxiv-datamining : Reference for handling of xiv equipment ids, CSV databases of items/dyes
  • xivdev/Penumbra : Reference for SqPack paths, race/gender handling and rendering of equipment
  • Ottermandias/Glamourer : Reference for handling of colors/facial/character features
  • SapphireServer/Sapphire : FFXIV DAT reader code reference
  • helpful-fox-senko-san/generate_index1 : FFXIV DAT reader code reference
  • xivapi/SaintCoinach : Reference for handling of xiv equipment ids

All data is stored on your device. Please make sure to regularly back-up your data through the export buttons to avoid data loss!

Settings

Removes loading screens when switching races with the trade-off of a much longer initial loading screen. May also impact memory usage.

Patch Notes

Firefox is not supported

Firefox has multiple discrepencies in its WebGPU implementation which cause models and textures to render incorrectly. These issues are not easy to debug and not easy to fix.

Workarounds have been tried but they do not fix all issues and have a considerable maintenance cost. As such Firefox is not supported. Support may be reconsidered when/if Firefox fixes these issues.

Please use a Chromium-based browser instead.

xivc
